title: BreakingChips — Machining math, done right.
excerpt: Free machining calculators for lathes and mills: spindle speed, feeds, chip load, threads, and shop math. Inch and metric. Works offline.
content_html:
Shop math, sourced and explained

Machining numbers you can check

46 calculators with the reference behind them, every figure sourced.

Calculators46, live as you typeMachines & toolingLathe, mill, CNCMaterials36 materialsFix a problemChatter, finish, taps

What an answer looks like

What the three marks mean →

  • Turning speeds and feeds calculatorSpeed, feed and depth for your material, insert and lathe.4140 annealed, CVD carbide → 542 SFM to start
  • Tap drill calculatorThe drill for any inch or metric tap, with percent of thread.1/4-20 UNC → #7 drill, 0.201 in, 75% thread, 5 of 5 charts
  • ISO fits and tolerances calculatorHole and shaft limits for any ISO fit, and the clearance.25 mm H7/g6 → 0.007 to 0.041 mm clearance
  • Bolt circle calculatorX and Y for every hole, ready to type into the control.6 holes on a 3.000 in circle → 1.500 in apart
  • SFM to RPM calculatorSurface speed and diameter in, spindle RPM out.300 SFM on a 0.500 in bar → 2,292 RPM
  • Chip load and feed rate calculatorFeed rate from chip load, flutes and RPM, or the other way.3 flutes at 0.003 in, 400 SFM on a 1/2 in end mill → 27.5 IPM
